name: OVH Groupe SA
summary: OVH Groupe S.A. is a worldwide provider of comprehensive digital infrastructure solutions, encompassing public and private cloud offerings, shared hosting, and dedicated server products. The company delivers Bare Metal Cloud, facilitating instant and automated provisioning of dedicated servers, alongside Hosted Private Cloud services, which leverage software-defined data center technology. Its portfolio also includes Public Cloud computing services, utilizing shared server resources, and various web cloud solutions aimed at assisting individuals and businesses with their digital transformation and growth. Furthermore, OVH extends its services to include domain name registration, telephony, and internet access. Operating approximately 400,000 servers across 33 data centers globally, OVH Groupe S.A. was established in 1999 and is headquartered in Roubaix, France.
